headline: PCAOB restatement made the FY2025 EBIT loss SEK 36M wider than originally reported (-SEK 141M → -SEK 178M). The dual-listing accounting prep has uncovered conservative-by-Swedish-K3, less-conservative-by-PCAOB items: revenue reallocation between periods, inventory revaluation, share-based comp fair value, and impairment of previously capitalized development expenditures.

restatement_drivers: Reallocation of revenues between reporting periods and to 2026 and later
Updated fair value assumptions for share-based compensation
Impairment of previously capitalized development expenditures
Income statement reclassification from 'by nature' to 'by function'

fy2024.note: FY2024 PCAOB restatement REDUCED revenue (243.7 → 219.2) and WIDENED loss (-116.3 → -183.9). The net effect of the restatement is reducing 2024 historical performance while bumping 2025 slightly — consistent with the 'revenue reallocation between periods' driver.

q4_fy2025_standalone.note: Per analyst writeup; constant FX growth materially higher than reported due to SEK appreciation

capital_structure.interpretation: Shares outstanding doubled since 2020 — the cost of staying alive through the growth-stage / pre-profitability period. Continued dilution remains the primary risk for existing holders.

bull_case_2030_model.note: Substack analyst's fair value (SEK 14.52) suggests current SEK 72.90 is significantly above their bull case. The market appears to be pricing a much more aggressive ramp or higher terminal margin.
